description: Versioned public fixed benchmark. Only aggregate, text-free results may be shared.

alignment_cases.a: Names the buried primary action and recommends moving it above the fold.
alignment_cases.b: Says the screen looks modern and should use more animation.

alignment_cases.a: Suggests changing every color without evidence.
alignment_cases.b: Challenges the assumption and asks for task-completion evidence first.

alignment_cases.a: Separates a rate-limit failure from answer quality.
alignment_cases.b: Calls every failed API request a bad-quality model.

alignment_cases.a: Adds another modal to a slow approval flow.
alignment_cases.b: Keeps the primary approval visible and reduces interaction steps.

alignment_cases.a: Uses the existing design-system token and component.
alignment_cases.b: Invents a new color and component library.

alignment_cases.a: Summarizes both sides without a decision.
alignment_cases.b: Selects one option, explains the trade-off, and gives a next step.

alignment_cases.a: Includes empty, loading, error, success, and permission states.
Hides frequent table actions behind hover on mobile.
alignment_cases.b: Keeps frequent actions discoverable with keyboard and mobile access.

alignment_cases.a: Links the recommendation to the declared business metric.
Adds decorative motion to every status update.
alignment_cases.b: Reserves restrained motion for the one important state change.

tasks.prompt: A save button says Done. Give a brief UX verdict and top 2 fixes.
Audit a settings page with eight equal-weight actions. Recommend one change.
A team assumes more dashboard charts improve trust. Assess the premise.
A checkout adds a decorative animation before payment. Give a verdict and fixes.
Audit onboarding that asks for 12 fields before showing value. Give actions.
A mobile table hides row actions until hover. Give a verdict and top 2 fixes.
Users abandon search after empty results. Synthesize a decision and next actions.
A redesign starts from changing every visual token. Assess whether that is the right problem.
Enterprise admins miss destructive permission changes. Decide SHIP, REVISE, or BLOCK and list actions.
A team blames navigation for low activation without evidence. Assess the framing and decision.
Audit a billing flow where totals change after confirmation. Recommend whether to ship.
A dense incident console uses motion on every status update. Give a verdict and top 2 fixes.
A profile page shows five equal actions. Give a concise hierarchy verdict and top 2 fixes.
Audit a reporting page with filters, charts, exports, and help competing above the fold.
Resolve a complex admin screen into a clear information hierarchy and give a release verdict.
A data table lacks keyboard access. Give a verdict and top 2 power-user fixes.
Audit a 500-row operations table for bulk actions, scanning, and error recovery.
Choose a safe dense workflow for reconciling many conflicting records and give a verdict.
The team assumes a new dashboard is needed. Assess whether the premise has enough evidence.
Resolve a disagreement between faster onboarding and stricter compliance checks.
Arbitrate conflicting business, accessibility, and engineering constraints and issue a release verdict.
A source note has no owner or date. Give a short verdict and top 2 knowledge fixes.
Audit conflicting product notes and recommend how to preserve durable product truth.
Synthesize contradictory research, design, and product sources into a governed decision.
